name: 5-(2-aminopropyl)-2-methoxyphenol
summary: 3-Hydroxy-4-methoxyamphetamine is an amphetamine and a known metabolite of the entactogen MDMA in rodents and humans. The essential oil analogues and precursors are chavibetol and isochavibetol, and can be converted into 3-hydroxy-4-methoxyamphetamine via amination.

uses.en: It is studied in the laboratory, mainly as a breakdown product of MDMA used to detect MDMA use.
uses.zh: 它主要在實驗室中作為MDMA的代謝產物被研究，用於檢測MDMA的使用。
uses.zhHans: 它主要在实验室中作为MDMA的代谢产物被研究，用于检测MDMA的使用。

fact.en: It is one of the compounds the body makes when it breaks down MDMA. It can also be made from chavibetol, a fragrant compound found in betel leaf oil.
fact.zh: 它是身體分解MDMA時產生的化合物之一。它也可以由chavibetol製成，那是一種存在於檳榔葉油中的芳香成分。
fact.zhHans: 它是身体分解MDMA时产生的化合物之一。它也可以由chavibetol制成，那是一种存在于槟榔叶油中的芳香成分。
